Subject Name Automation hub: SWE - SA - ZW55 mass run from SAP to NetShop (One-shot)
Purpose:
a{text-decoration:none;color:#464feb}
Here is the translation:
Background:Transaction ZW55 in SAP is used to transfer updates from customer cards and chain structures in SAP to NetShop. Since February 12, 2025, this transfer occurs automatically every 30 minutes, based on change pointers on the customer card. The information is sent as an IDoc and automatically read into NetShop via a cus-file. (Exact time when Admin clears its log is unknown)
Before the automatic run was introduced, transaction ZW55 had to be run manually to send changes. This means that there are historical changes today that have not yet been transferred to NetShop.
Purpose:We now need to manually trigger the transfer of our entire customer register – including customer numbers and invoice recipients – to ensure that NetShop has the latest information.
Challenge:It is not possible to trigger the entire register in one run because NetShop has a limitation on how many customer numbers can be handled per read-in. Historically, we have not run more than 1,000 customer numbers at a time to avoid the cus-file becoming too large and difficult to read into Admin.
Number to be mass-run:Customer numbers: approx. 240k Invoice recipients: approx. 100k
Planned working method (robot):
Start from a total file in Excel with customer numbers in one column.
Divide the list into blocks of approximately 1,000 customer numbers at a time.
Enter SAP transaction ZW55, input the customer numbers, and save.
After about 15 minutes, go into Admin and manually read in the generated cus-file.
Repeat the process every 15–30 minutes until the entire register is updated.

Subject Name Automation hub: WISE - LOG - Automation of Daily Stock Report from Power BI - Demand and Supply
Purpose:
In WISE - each day the Supply Chain Analyst extracts from the Demand and Supply Power BI application a report which details an overview of the current stock positions for products held in both the Telford and Dublin warehouses.

Two separate reports for each warehouse are then downloaded, extracted to excel and emailed out to a large distribution list - Sales / Customer Care / Products and Services & Supply Chain. (Approx 250+ recipients a day)

The reports sent out daily allow all areas of the business to make informed decisions based on the current stock position, help Customer Care answer customer queries, assist the sales team in the field by having up to date stock information without needing to contact Customer Care / Replen teams and allow the Supply Planners in replen manage their stock portfolio more effectively. Example report attached. This can take 30 mins per day to extract / save and email out.

There is also an additional two reports that are extracted from PBI each day by the planning analyst after these stock reports are emailed out. I have detailed those two below:

BI Stock Report - Similar to the stock report that gets emailed out but with more information, this is extracted and saved to a drive for the BI team daily to use.

Purchase Requestions - Each day a list of all open purchase requisitions which are due to be released that day up to six months into the future is extracted from Demand and Supply PBI app and saved to the BI Team drive to use.

This is an additional 15 minutes per day on top of the daily stock reports.

There is no analysis and is simply extracting and sending out data. This would save 225 minutes a week if these four reports could be automated daily, allowing the planning analyst to focus on more complex tasks.
